tooltip.caveinstability.delay_ticks: Time in ticks before an unsupported block is turned into a falling block.
tooltip.caveinstability.horizontal_range: Maximum horizontal distance a cave in can spread from the original support loss.
tooltip.caveinstability.vertical_range: Maximum vertical distance a cave in can spread from the original support loss.
tooltip.caveinstability.source_cave_in_c: Fallback chance that a cave in begins when support is removed, used when a block or tag entry does not specify its own value.
tooltip.caveinstability.enable_debris_sl: When enabled, falling debris may slide sideways downhill when it lands on stable terrain.
tooltip.caveinstability.max_debris_slide: Limits how many sideways downhill moves a single debris block may attempt.
tooltip.caveinstability.enable_floating_: When enabled, connected collapsible blocks left fully suspended in air can all collapse together.
tooltip.caveinstability.floating_group_s: Maximum number of connected collapsible blocks checked when testing whether a floating group should collapse.
tooltip.caveinstability.enable_support_p: When enabled, nearby support pillars can prevent a cave in from starting.
tooltip.caveinstability.support_check_ra: Horizontal radius around the trigger source used to search for valid support pillars.
tooltip.caveinstability.support_vertical: How many blocks below the trigger source a support pillar may still count.
tooltip.caveinstability.support_above_to: How many blocks above the trigger source a support pillar may still count.
tooltip.caveinstability.support_entries: List of support block ids or tags that can count as part of a pillar. A valid pillar must have one or more support blocks in a vertical column, at least two collapsible blocks above its top, and at least two solid blocks below its base.
tooltip.caveinstability.support_entries_: Add a new support block id or tag entry.
tooltip.caveinstability.falling_entries: List of collapsible block ids or tags. Format examples: minecraft:stone, minecraft:stone=0.35, #minecraft:base_stone_overworld, #minecraft:dirt=0.50
tooltip.caveinstability.falling_entries_: Add a new block id or tag entry.
